description: List account categories (chart of accounts). Use when the user asks about their chart of accounts, account codes, or available categories for categorizing transactions. On a national chart an account marked takes_postings: false is a heading with analytic accounts under it: never post, categorise or journal to it, use one of its analytic accounts (the longer codes that start with its code) or add one with create_account_category.

company.description: Which company to read, by name or id, when the account has more than one (see list_companies). Leave it out to use the only company, or the default.

type.description: Filter by type: income, expense, asset, liability, equity, cost_of_sales

name: get_chart_of_accounts
title: Get Chart Of Accounts
